value.value: In the heart of Sofia, Éste is Bulgaria's most exacting expression of modern luxury dining — a frosted-glass sanctuary of gold light, cold caviar, deep cellars and living, seasonal cuisine.
Choose a chapter. Every dish is available à la carte or within the twelve-course tasting.
Private tastings, cellar releases and seasonal menus — delivered first to our closest guests.

We cook from the Bulgarian land and the seas that border it — Rhodope veal, Black Sea fish, wild herbs and rose. Every plate is composed with the same clarity as the room around it: white marble, brushed gold, frosted glass and candlelight. Nothing loud. Everything considered.
Restraint, warmth, and a little gold.
Guided by our head sommelier — from grower champagne to the finest of Bulgaria's own valleys. Select a flight and tap a bottle to reveal its tasting notes.

formula.value: The most exclusive dining experience on earth. A precise, minimalist tasting sequence.
Cultured caviar, frozen crème, gold leaf
Aged wagyu, white truffle, bone marrow
Black cod, squid ink, edible ash
The Laboratory opens for a single evening. Twelve guests, one sequence, no repetition. What is served here is served once.
We do not season to please. We measure the properties of matter — temperature, mass, yield — until beauty is the only remaining outcome.
Every element is traceable to a single origin and a single batch. Lineage is recorded to the hour. Anonymity is not permitted on the plate.
Between expressions, we serve stillness. The evening is scored like music, with rests as deliberate as the notes.
There is no reservation line. Applications are reviewed in confidence. The table finds its guests, not the reverse.
Precision is the only luxury. Everything else is decoration.
I do not cook. I measure matter until it agrees to become beautiful.
Core temperature to a tenth of a degree
A single batch. A single origin. Traceable to the hour it was drawn.
Silence is a course. We serve it between the others.
Roe drawn at dawn, frozen within the hour, gilded on arrival.
Single-lineage cattle, marbled to a grade held in confidence.
Hunted under moonlight, weighed and sealed at the tree.
Cold-water crustacean, iced in consommé aboard the vessel.
A single cellar's reserve, misted under liquid nitrogen.
Estate-raised, gilded in 24k, married to fermented pear.

formula.value: The doors reopen to autumn. A twelve-movement dinner of game, chestnut and amber wine, served beneath a canopy of turning leaves and gilded candlelight.
An evening in the cellar. Rare vintages and library pours guided flight by flight, each poured tableside and paired with a single gilded morsel — the house sommelier presiding until the last glass.
One night only. A masked dinner in obsidian and candle-smoke \u2014 black truffle, squid ink and burning sugar \u2014 conducted in near-darkness until the final gilded course.
The first seating of the new carte. The kitchen unveils a season of new compositions in a single guided procession — every course a debut, presented before it reaches the room at large.
A midwinter ceremony beneath a thousand lights. Aged wagyu, white truffle and champagne mist \u2014 the house at its most opulent, gilded end to end for a single seating.
The final evening. A caviar and gold tasting sequence timed to the stroke of midnight, closed with nitrogen citrus and a toast of vintage cuv\u00e9e as the year turns.
A quiet, glacial dinner. Langoustine on iced consomm\u00e9, forced winter blooms and white chocolate spheres \u2014 the cold garden brought to the table under glass.

meta.description: The Gardens of Este — a rich, intricate herbarial section celebrating the seasonal gardens, transformed through the cold. A soft green and gold botanical panel in the house style.

description.value: Open seasonally, the gardens are a living cabinet of herbs, blossom and root — coaxed into being through the warm months and quietly transformed when the cold regions descend. Every leaf is matter for the table.

value.value: Open seasonally · Transformed through the cold · Every leaf, matter for the table

value.value: the gardens do not close — they change costume. Beds are drawn under gilded glass, forced blooms and bitter greens carry the season, and the table never wants for the living leaf.

Rows of green run to the glasshouse and back — tarragon, lovage, wild sorrel and a hundred quieter things. What the frost claims above ground, the cold garden keeps below, gilded and dormant, waiting.

value.value: Discreet arrival and departure. Your vehicle is received, sheltered and returned by white-gloved attendants.
A standing seat held in your name, priority on every seasonal sequence, and access to the house's most private evenings.
Descend into a gilded vault of the world's rarest bottles, reserved exclusively for the house and its members.
Step behind the pass into the laboratory itself, where each dish is composed before you as a private commission.
Every piece we lay is Villeroy & Boch — the most expensive cutlery on earth. Hand-forged, gold-inlaid instruments weighed to the gram for each course.
A single marble chamber for one seating a night — total seclusion, a private kitchen, and the chef at your table.
A fleet of appointed cars collects you from any address in the country and returns you when the evening is complete.
One attaché anticipates every wish — from itinerary to invitation — through the entire evening and beyond.
A dedicated master pairs each course from a cellar of rare vintages, reserve champagnes and single-cask spirits.

meta.description: Este delivery strategy — the café lives on aggregators; the restaurant keeps its own black-car service. A two-tier story panel in the house glass-and-gold style.
